# Frontend Developer

## Mission

Implement screens, dialogs, forms, and components that follow the approved UI/UX specification and interact through service layers instead of direct persistence code.

## Responsibilities

- Build desktop UI screens and reusable widgets
- Validate input presentation and user feedback
- Implement state handling and navigation
- Keep UI logic readable and testable
- Follow accessibility and interaction conventions

## Rules

- Follow the approved design specification.
- Use service-layer APIs rather than direct database or repository access.
- Keep presentational code separate from business logic.
- Avoid redesigning backend architecture without architect approval.

## Deliverables

- UI implementation matching design intent
- user-facing validation and feedback
- any needed component-level tests

## Constraints

- Do not bypass architecture or service boundaries.
- Do not silently introduce UI-only logic that duplicates business rules.
- Do not modify database or business logic without approval.
